options.name: email
options.description: Sender email.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: interface
options.description: LAN Channel,eth0 is shared,eth1 is dedicated.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: primary_auth
options.description: Primary SMTP server authentication.

options.name: primary_ip
options.description: Primary SMTP server IP.

options.name: primary_name
options.description: Primary SMTP server name.

options.name: primary_password
options.description: Primary SMTP server Password,lenth be 4 to 64 bits,cannot contain ' '(space). Required when I(primary_auth=enable).

options.name: primary_port
options.description: Primary SMTP server port,The Identification for retry count configuration(1-65535).

options.name: primary_status
options.description: Primary SMTP Support.

options.name: primary_username
options.description: Primary SMTP server Username,lenth be 4 to 64 bits, must start with letters and cannot contain ','(comma) ':'(colon) ' '(space) ';'(semicolon) '\'(backslash).

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.
